verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On for enterprise applications, and a community user describes using it for multi-tenant SSO. That suggests each customer could get its own SSO connection. The pack never documents per-organization connection management, domain verification, or just-in-time provisioning. Missing for 10: per-organization SSO connection docs, verified-domain configuration, just-in-time user provisioning, OIDC-based enterprise SSO, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can give each customer organization its own SSO connection with verified domains and just-in-time provisioning

citations.quote: Add Single Sign-On for enterprise applications with SAML 2.0.
A user new to implementing multi-tenant SSO was excited about Supabase's SAML SSO.
